IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r2.claim: Ibn Ishaq says Hanna was barren, longed for a child after seeing a bird feed its chick, prayed, conceived after her husband approached her, and vowed the child once she confirmed the pregnancy.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r2.anchor: قال محمد بن إسحاق: وكانت امرأة لا تحمل، فرأت يوما طائرا يزق فرخه، فاشتهت الولد،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r3.claim: Hanna vowed the child as freed for worship and service in the Jerusalem temple.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r3.anchor: أي: خالصا مفرغا للعبادة، ولخدمة بيت المقدس، فقالت: {رب إني نذرت لك ما في بطني محررا فتقبل مني

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r4.claim: She asks God to accept her vow because He hears her prayer and knows her intention.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r4.anchor: أي: السميع لدعائي، العليم بنيتي، ولم تكن تعلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r5.claim: When she made the vow, Hanna did not know whether the child in her womb was male or female.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p33#2/r5.anchor: ولم تكن تعلم ما في بطنها أذكرا أم أنثى؟

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r2.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب وأبو بكر عن عاصم وابن عامر ويعقوب
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r2.claim: ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib, Abū Bakr from ʿĀṣim, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Yaʿqūb read waḍaʿtu with the tāʾ marked as her quoted speech.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r2.anchor: قرأ علي بن أبي طالب (عليه السلام) وأبو بكر عن عاصم وابن عامر ويعقوب وضعت برفع التاء

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r4.claim: A vow is something a person obligates himself to do; nadhr al-dam means imposing on oneself the duty of killing oneself.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r4.anchor: النذر: ما يوجبه الإنسان على نفسه

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r5.claim: Jishumi notes that yūfūna bi-l-nadhr was revealed concerning ʿAlī and his household.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r5.anchor: ومنه: (يوفون بالنذر) نزل في علي وأهل بيته

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r6.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r6.claim: Muḥarraran may mean liberated or manumitted, as in freeing a slave; another explanation derives it from editing a book, purifying and correcting it.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r6.anchor: محررا فقيل: هو التحرير وهو العتق، ومنه: (وتحرير رقبة)

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r7.claim: Taqabbul is accepting something willingly and favorably, as one accepts a gift.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r7.anchor: والتقبل: أخذ الشيء على الرضا به كتقبل الهدية

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r10.speaker: الأخفش وأبو العباس
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r10.claim: Al-Akhfash and Abū al-ʿAbbās parse idh as an accusative governed by an implied udhkur, remember.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r10.anchor: الأول: نصب ب (اذكر) إذ قالت، عن الأخفش وأبي العباس

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r11.speaker: الزجاج
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r11.claim: Al-Zajjāj connects idh to the earlier statement that God chose ʿImrān's family.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r11.anchor: الثاني: ب (اصطفى آل عمران) إذ قالت، عن الزجاج

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r12.speaker: علي بن عيسى
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r12.claim: ʿAlī b. ʿĪsā relates idh to the meanings of All-Knowing and All-Hearing: God knew her intention and words.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r12.anchor: بمعنى سميع عليم إذ قالت، فيعمل فيه معنى الصفتين على تقدير: مدرك لنيتها وقولها

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r13.speaker: أبو عبيدة
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r13.claim: Abū ʿUbayda treats idh as extra, but Jishumi rejects this because it has a meaningful function.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r13.anchor: الرابع: (إذ) زائدة فلا موضع لها من الإعراب، عن أبي عبيدة، وهذا غير صحيح

JISHUMI:v2p1146/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r14.claim: Muḥarraran is accusative as a circumstantial qualifier; the verb nadhr governs it.
JISHUMI:v2p1146/r14.anchor: محررا نصب على الحال على تقدير: نذرت لك الذي في بطني محررا، والعامل فيه نذرت

JISHUMI:v2p1162/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1162/r6.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v2p1162/r6.claim: One parsing makes idh governed by samīʿ ʿalīm in the account of ʿImrān's wife, with the angels' statement coordinated to it; another supplies remember.
JISHUMI:v2p1162/r6.anchor: عامل الإعراب في (إذ) قيل: قوله: سميع عليم (إذ قالت امرأة عمران) ثم عطف عليه، وإذ قالت الملائكة

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r1.speaker: الشعبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r1.claim: Al-Shabi interprets the vowed child as devoted exclusively to worship.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r1.anchor: محررا أي مخلصا للعبادة , وهذا قول الشعبي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r2.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r2.claim: Mujahid interprets the vow as a servant dedicated to the church.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r2.anchor: والثاني : يعني خادما للبيعة , وهذا قول مجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r3.speaker: محمد بن جعفر بن الزبير
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r3.claim: Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn al-Zubayr understands the vow as freeing the child from worldly concerns for God's service.
MAWARDI-FULL:v1p386/r3.anchor: والثالث : يعني عتيقا من الدنيا لطاعة الله , وهذا قول محمد بن جعفر بن الزبير .

MUQATIL:3:35/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:3:35/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:3:35/r1.claim: Imran, son of Mathan, was married to Hannah daughter of Faqudh, Mary’s mother; while pregnant, she vowed the child to God’s service if God saved her and she gave birth.
MUQATIL:3:35/r1.anchor: بن ماثانا، اسمها حنة بنت فاقوز، وهى أم مريم

MUQATIL:3:35/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:3:35/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:3:35/r2.claim: Banu Mathan were Israelite kings descended from David; a consecrated child would avoid worldly work and marriage, serve the afterlife, and worship in the sanctuary.
MUQATIL:3:35/r2.anchor: وبنو ماثان من ملوك بنى إسرائيل من نسل داود، عليه السلام

MUQATIL:3:35/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:3:35/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:3:35/r3.claim: Only boys were consecrated in that era, so Hannah’s husband worried what she would do if the child were a girl, whom he called vulnerable; Hannah became concerned.
MUQATIL:3:35/r3.anchor: لم يكن يحرر فى ذلك الزمان إلا الغلمان

MUQATIL:3:35/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:3:35/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:3:35/r4.claim: Hannah asks God to accept her vow; He hears their supplication and knows their vow.
MUQATIL:3:35/r4.anchor: لدعائهما، العليم بنذرهما، يعنى بالتقبل والاستجابة لدعائهما

NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r1.claim: The adverb «idh» is governed by «qālat» or by an omitted imperative «remember».
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r1.anchor: وإذ منصوب به أو باضمار اذكر

NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r2.claim: The wife of ʿImrān ibn Māthān, Mary’s mother and Jesus’s grandmother, was Ḥanna daughter of Fāqūdhā.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r2.anchor: هى امرأة عمران بن ماثان أم مريم جدة عيسى وهى حنة بنت فاقوذا

NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r3.claim: «Nadhartu» means she made something binding upon herself.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r3.anchor: أوجبت ﴿ ما في بطني محررا ﴾ هو حال من ما

NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r4.claim: She vowed the child in her womb as freed for service at the Jerusalem sanctuary, beyond her control and not for her use; this vow was lawful then.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r4.anchor: بمعنى الذى أى معتقا لخدمة بيت المقدس لا يد لى عليه ولا أستخدمه

NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r5.claim: Another gloss takes «muḥarrar» as devoted purely to worship, like «ḥurr» for pure clay.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r5.anchor: أو مخلصا للعبادة يقال طين حر أى خالص

NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r6.speaker: مدنى وأبو عمرو
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r6.claim: The Medinan reader and Abū ʿAmr read «fa-taqabbal minnī»; taqabbul is acceptance with approval.
NASAFI-FULL:v1p150#5/r6.anchor: فتقبل مني ﴾ مدنى و أبو عمرو والتقبل أخذ الشئ على الرضا به

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r1.claim: The temporal particle idh is governed by an understood imperative meaning remember.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r1.anchor: {إذ} منصوب باذكر {قالت امرأت عمران} وهي امرأة عمران

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r2.claim: The woman is Hannah daughter of Faqudha, wife of ʿImran ibn Mathan, mother of the Virgin Mary, and grandmother of Jesus.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r2.anchor: وهي امرأة عمران بن ماثان أم مريم البتول جدة عيسى عليه السلام وهي حنة بنت فاقوذا

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r3.claim: Bursevi distinguishes this ʿImran from ʿImran ibn Yashhar, father of Miriam, Moses and Aaron's sister: Zachariah's guardianship shows Mary was ʿImran ibn Mathan's daughter, and Zachariah and ʿImran were contemporaries; Zachariah married Mary's sister, making John and Jesus cousins.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r3.anchor: كفى بكفالة زكريا دليلا على أنه عمران أبو البتول لأن زكريا بن أذن وعمران بن ماثان كانا في عصر واحد

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r4.claim: Hannah was barren into old age; seeing a bird feed its chick stirred her wish for a child, and she vowed to dedicate a child to serve the Temple; she conceived Mary and ʿImran died during the pregnancy.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r4.anchor: بينا هي في ظل شجرة بصرت بطائر يطعم فرخا له فتحركت نفسها للولد وتمنته

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r5.claim: Her vow was an act of gratitude: if granted a child, she would give the child to the Jerusalem sanctuary as one of its attendants.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r5.anchor: قالت : اللهم إن لك علي نذرا شكرا إن رزقتني ولدا أن أتصدق به على بيت المقدس

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r6.claim: A vow is something a person makes binding upon himself.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r6.anchor: والنذر ما يوجبه الإنسان على نفسه

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r7.claim: The verse uses the nonhuman relative pronoun for the child because the child's status was unknown and the fetus was not yet at the level of rational persons.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r7.anchor: عبر عن الولد بما لإبهام أمره وقصوره عن درجة العقلاء

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r8.claim: Muḥarraran means freed for Temple service, beyond the mother's use or employment, or wholly devoted to worship without worldly work or marriage.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r8.anchor: أي : معتقا لخدمة بيت المقدس لا يد لي عليه ولا أستخدمه ولا أشغله بشيء

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r9.claim: Such dedication was lawful for them: children otherwise owed service to their parents when capable, and a vow released them for sanctuary service; prophets had dedicated offspring, and only boys were normally dedicated because menstruation and impurity required girls to leave.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r9.anchor: وكان هذا النذر مشروعا عندهم لأن الأمر في دينهم أن الولد إذا صار بحيث يمكن استخدامه

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r10.claim: Hannah dedicated the fetus without qualification either because she assumed it would be male or because she used the vow as a means of asking for a son.
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r10.anchor: ولكن حررت حنة ما في بطنها مطلقا إما لأنها بنت الأمر على تقدير الذكورة

BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#2/r11.claim: Accepting means taking something with approval; Hannah asks God to accept what she vowed.

BURSEVI:v2p21#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p21#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p21#3/r1.claim: Her request for acceptance is really a request for a son, since acceptance presupposes an existing offering and, by their custom, a girl could not be accepted for Temple service.
BURSEVI:v2p21#3/r1.anchor: وهذا في الحقيقة استدعاء للولد إذ لا يتصور القبول بدون تحقق المقبول بل للولد الذكر

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r1.speaker: أبو عبيدة
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r1.claim: Abū ʿUbayda treats إذ as extra.

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r2.speaker: محمد بن يزيد
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r2.claim: Muḥammad ibn Yazīd supplies an implied command to remember the time.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r2.anchor: وقال محمد ابن يزيد: التقدير اذكر إذ

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r3.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r3.claim: Al-Zajjāj connects the clause to God’s choosing Imran’s family when his wife spoke.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r3.anchor: وقال الزجاج: المعنى واصطفى آل عمران إذ قالت امرأة عمران

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r4.claim: Imran’s wife was Ḥanna daughter of Fāqūd ibn Qunbul, Mary’s mother and Jesus’s grandmother.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r4.anchor: وهي حنة بالحاء المهملة والنون بنت فاقود بن قنبل أم مريم جدة عيسى عليه السلام

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r5.claim: Ḥanna is not Arabic or known as an Arabic woman’s name; he notes Abu Ḥinna/Abu Ḥibba and rare forms from Ibn Makula.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r5.anchor: وليس باسم عربي ولا يعرف في العربية حنة اسم امرأة. وفي العربية أبو حنة البدري

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r6.speaker: أبو نواس
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r6.claim: Abū Nuwās names a monastery of Ḥanna in Syria.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r6.anchor: قال أبو نواس: يا دير حنة من ذات الأكيراح من يصح عنك فإني لست بالصاحي

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r7.claim: A vow binds only when a person imposes it upon themselves.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r7.anchor: تقدم معنى النذر، وأنه لا يلزم العبد إلا بأن يلزمه نفسه

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r8.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r8.claim: One account says she vowed during pregnancy, if God saved her and she delivered, to dedicate the child to God.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r8.anchor: ويقال: إنها لما حملت قالت: لئن نجاني الله ووضعت ما في بطني لجعلته محررا

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r9.claim: Here لك means for Your worship.

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r10.claim: He prefers parsing محررا as a circumstantial accusative rather than an adjective of an elided noun.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r10.anchor: «محررا» نصب على الحال، وقيل: نعت لمفعول محذوف، أي إني نذرت لك

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r11.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r11.claim: One account says elderly, childless Hanne saw a bird feed its chick, prayed for a child, and vowed dedication if granted one.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r11.anchor: فقيل إن سبب قول امرأة عمران هذا أنها كانت كبيرة لا تلد، وكانوا أهل بيت من الله بمكان

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r12.claim: The child was freed from worldly claims and dedicated to God’s church service and worship, valid in their law.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r12.anchor: أي عتيقا خالصا لله تعالى، خادما للكنيسة حبيسا عليها، مفرغا لعبادة الله تعالى

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r14.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r14.claim: Ibn al-ʿArabī says a free woman cannot make her child the object of a binding vow because she cannot own the child.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r14.anchor: قال ابن العربي: «لا خلاف أن امرأة عمران لا يتطرق إلى حملها نذر لكونها حرة

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r15.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r15.claim: Ibn al-ʿArabī explains that a child is sought for comfort and support, and Hanne renounced that benefit to dedicate the child to God.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36/r15.anchor: فطلبت هذه المرأة الولد أنسا به وسكونا إليه فلما من الله تعالى عليها به نذرت

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r1.claim: Hanne intended to free the child from her own claims and worldly bondage so he could worship and learn.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r1.anchor: وأرادت به محررا من جهتي، محررا من رق الدنيا وأشغالها

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r2.speaker: رجل من الصوفية
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r2.claim: A Sufi story tells of a son who asked his mother to release him for worship and study; she later said she had given him to God.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r2.anchor: وقد قال رجل من الصوفية لأمه: يا أمه: ذريني لله أتعبد له وأتعلم العلم

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r3.claim: Muḥarrar derives from freedom opposite slavery; تحرير a book means clearing it of disorder and corruption.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r3.anchor: مأخوذ من الحرية التي هي ضد العبودية من هذا تحرير الكتاب، وهو تخليصه

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r4.speaker: عكرمة ومجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r4.claim: ʿIkrima and Mujāhid define muḥarrar as devoted to God without worldly admixture.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r4.anchor: روى خصيف عن عكرمة ومجاهد: أن المحرر الخالص لله عز وجل لا يشوبه شيء

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r5.speaker: ذو الرمة
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r5.claim: Dhū al-Rumma uses ḥurra for purity in his line about an earring on the earlobe.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r5.anchor: قال ذو الرمة: والقرط في حرة الذفرى معلقه تباعد الحبل منه فهو يضطرب

QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r6.claim: Pure clay without sand is ḥurr; an unconsummated first wedding night is called free.
QURTUBI-FULL:3:35-36#2/r6.anchor: وطين حر لا رمل فيه، وباتت فلانة بليلة حرة إذا لم يصل إليها زوجها أول ليلة

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r1.speaker: أبو عبيدة
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r1.claim: Abu Ubayda treats idh as a redundant particle with no syntactic position.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r1.anchor: قال أبو عبيدة : إنها زائدة لغوا ، والمعنى : قالت امرأة عمران ، ولا موضع لها من الإعراب

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r2.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r2.claim: Al-Zajjaj rejects this analysis because a particle of God's Book cannot be canceled or deleted without necessity.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r2.anchor: قال الزجاج : لم يصنع أبو عبيدة في هذا شيئا ، لأنه لا يجوز إلغاء حرف من كتاب الله تعالى

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r3.speaker: الأخفش والمبرد
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r3.claim: Al-Akhfash and al-Mubarrad supply an implied command: “Remember when the wife of Imran said.”
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r3.anchor: قال الأخفش والمبرد : التقدير اذكر { إذ قالت امرأت عمران } ومثله في كتاب الله تعالى كثير

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r4.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r4.claim: Al-Zajjaj links idh to God's choice of Imran's family, specifying when that selection appeared.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r4.anchor: قال الزجاج ، التقدير : واصطفى آل عمران على العالمين إذ قالت امرأة

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r5.speaker: ابن الأنباري
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r5.claim: Ibn al-Anbari objects that selection cannot be restricted to Hanna's speech, since Adam and Noah were selected earlier.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r5.anchor: وطعن ابن الأنباري فيه وقال : إن الله تعالى قرن اصطفاء آل عمران باصطفاء آدم ونوح

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r6.claim: Razi answers that each selection becomes manifest when the person or family exists and performs acts of obedience.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r6.anchor: ويمكن أن يجاب عنه بأن أثر اصطفاء كل واحد إنما ظهرر عند وجوده ، وظهور طاعاته

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r7.claim: A further analysis connects idh to the preceding “God is Hearing, Knowing”: He hears this statement when she makes it.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r7.anchor: قال بعضهم : هذا متعلق بما قبله ، والتقدير : والله سميع عليم إذ قالت امرأة

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r8.claim: God always hears and knows; hearing this speech and knowledge of her utterance are related to their occurrence, so change is in relations and objects.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r8.anchor: إن سمعه تعالى لذلك الكلام مقيد بوجود ذلك الكلام وعلمه تعالى بأنها تذكر ذلك مقيد بذكرها لذلك

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r9.claim: The account identifies Zakariyya as son of Adhan, Imran as son of Mathan, Hanna as Imran's wife, and Yahya and Isa as maternal cousins; Zakariyya married Hanna's daughter Esha, Mary's sister.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r9.anchor: أن زكريا بن أذن ، وعمران بن ماثان ، كانا في عصر واحد ، وامرأة عمران حنة بنت فاقوذ

RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r10.speaker: عكرمة
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r10.claim: Ikrimah reports that barren Hanna envied women with children and vowed to dedicate any child God gave her to the Jerusalem sanctuary as a servant.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22/r10.anchor: قال عكرمة . إنها كانت عاقرا لا تلد ، وكانت تغبط النساء بالأولاد ، ثم قالت

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r1.speaker: محمد بن إسحاق
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r1.claim: Ibn Ishaq says Hanna was childless until old age, saw a bird feed its chick, prayed for a child, conceived Mary, and after Imran died dedicated her as a temple servant.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r1.anchor: الرواية الثانية : قال محمد بن إسحاق : إن أم مريم ما كان يحصل لها ولد حتى شاخت ، وكانت يوما في ظل شجرة

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r2.speaker: الحسن البصري
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r2.claim: Al-Hasan al-Basri says God inspired Hanna's vow; he compares it with Abraham understanding his dream-sacrifice command and Moses' mother being inspired to cast him into the river, neither by revelation.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r2.anchor: قال الحسن البصري : إنها إنما فعلت ذلك بإلهام من الله ولولاه ما فعلت كما رأى إبراهيم ذبح ابنه

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r3.claim: Muharrar means made free and pure: a freed slave, a corrected text, a person belonging wholly to himself, or clay free of impurities.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r3.anchor: المحرر الذي جعل حرا خالصا ، يقال : حررت العبد إذا خلصته عن الرق ، وحررت الكتاب إذا أصلحته

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r4.speaker: الشعبي
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r4.claim: Al-Sha'bi interprets the dedication as making the child wholly devoted to worship.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r4.anchor: أما التفسير فقيل مخلصا للعبادة عن الشعبي ، وقيل : خادما للبيعة

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r5.claim: Other interpretations make the child a church servant, free of worldly affairs for God's obedience, or a servant who studies and teaches scripture.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r5.anchor: وقيل : خادما للبيعة ، وقيل : عتيقا من أمر الدنيا لطاعة الله ، وقيل : خادما لمن يدرس الكتاب

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r6.claim: The vow meant dedicating the child wholly to worship and service of God.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r6.anchor: والمعنى أنها نذرت أن تجعل ذلك الولد وقفا على طاعة الله ، قال الأصم

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r7.speaker: الأصم
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r7.claim: Al-Asamm says Israelites had no booty or captives; children normally served parents once able, so the vow renounced that benefit and assigned them to sanctuary service.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r7.anchor: قال الأصم : لم يكن لبني إسرائيل غنيمة ولا سبي ، فكان تحريرهم جعلهم أولادهم على الصفة

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r8.claim: Another account says a dedicated child served in the church until puberty, then chose whether to leave or remain; every prophet had a descendant dedicated at Jerusalem.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r8.anchor: وقيل : كان المحرر يجعل في الكنيسة يقوم بخدمتها حتى يبلغ الحلم ، ثم يخير بين المقام والذهاب

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r9.claim: Dedication was allowed only for boys, since menstruation and its hardship made girls unsuitable for sanctuary service.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r9.anchor: هذا التحرير لم يكن جائزا إلا في الغلمان أما الجارية فكانت لا تصلح لذلك لما يصيبها من الحيض ، والأذى

RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r10.claim: Hanna made the vow without a gender condition either because she assumed the child would be male or used the vow to seek a son.
RAZI-FULL:v8p22#2/r10.anchor: ثم إن حنة نذرت مطلقا إما لأنها بنت الأمر على التقدير ، أو لأنها جعلت ذلك النذر وسيلة إلى طلب الذكر .

RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r1.claim: One parsing makes muharraran an accusative circumstantial qualifier of “what is in my womb.”
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r1.anchor: في انتصاب قوله { محررا } وجهان الأول : أنه نصب على الحال من { ما } وتقديره : نذرت لك الذي

RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r2.speaker: ابن قتيبة
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r2.claim: Ibn Qutayba reads the phrase as “I vowed that I would make what is in my womb consecrated.”
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r2.anchor: والثاني : وهو قول ابن قتيبة أن المعنى نذرت لك أن أجعل ما في بطني محررا .

RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r3.speaker: الواحدي
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r3.claim: Al-Wahidi derives taqabbal from muqabala: accepting by returning recompense.
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r3.anchor: قال الواحدي : وأصله من المقابلة لأنه يقبل بالجزاء

RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r4.claim: Hanna's request expresses that she sought only God's pleasure and sincerity in worship.
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r4.anchor: وهذا كلام من لا يريد بما فعله إلا الطلب لرضا الله تعالى والإخلاص في عبادته ، ثم قالت

RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r5.claim: God hears Hanna's supplication, call, and plea and knows her inner thoughts, heart, and intention.
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r5.anchor: والمعنى : أنك أنت السميع لتضرعي ودعائي وندائي ، العليم بما في ضميري وقلبي ونيتي

RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r6.claim: This kind of vow belonged to Israelite law, not Islamic law; revealed laws may differ on such rulings.
RAZI-FULL:v8p23/r6.anchor: واعلم أن هذا النوع من النذر كان في شرع بني إسرائيل وغير موجود في شرعنا ، والشرائع لا يمتنع اختلافها
